turns.text: But it didn't feel like a win because he said, he said he was only trying about 30 percent.
turns.zh: 但感觉不像赢了，因为他说，他说他只用了三成力。

turns.text: So that was… Do you think you'll ever beat him?
turns.zh: 所以那是……你觉得你以后能赢他吗？
